findings.title: Pause and Delete menu items are hidden for Grafana rules in the list view when rulerRule is omitted
findings.body: In `AlertRuleMenu.tsx`, `canPause` and `canDelete` are updated to check `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(promRule)` so that abilities work in the alert list view where `rulerRule` is no longer fetched. However, rendering the Pause menu item at line 123 still checks `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`, and rendering the Delete menu item at line 165 still checks `canDelete && rulerRule` (and `handleDelete` is typed as `(rule: RulerRuleDTO, groupIdentifier: RuleGroupIdentifierV2) => void`, even though `RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx` ignores the arguments and uses `identifier`). Additionally, in `RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx` line 104, `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`, so clicking "Silence notifications" in the list view sets `showSilenceDrawer(true)` without rendering the drawer. As a result, Grafana rules in the list view cannot be paused or deleted from the menu, and clicking "Silence notifications" does nothing.

findings.title: Recording rules and un-loaded folders have wrong ModifyExport and Silence abilities in useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities
findings.body: In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, `ModifyExport` is set to `[isAlertingRule, exportAllowed]` (line 324), whereas `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` sets it to `[isGrafanaManagedAlertRule, exportAllowed]` (which is true for both Grafana alerting and recording rules). Using `isAlertingRule` disables export for Grafana-managed recording rules. Additionally, `Silence` is set to `[silenceSupported, canSilenceInFolder && isAlertingRule]` (line 323) without checking that `rule` is defined or that `useFolder(rule?.folderUid)` has finished loading and returned a folder; if a user has the global `AlertingInstanceCreate` permission, `canSilenceInFolder` is `true` even while the folder is missing or still loading, unlike `useCanSilence` which returns `[false, false]` when `folderIsLoading || !folder`.

findings.title: Missing React `key` prop on `GrafanaRuleListItem` in `FilterViewResults`
findings.body: When replacing `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} ... />` with `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` inside `rules.map(...)`, the `key={key}` prop was dropped. Rendering list items in an array without a `key` triggers React warnings and can cause incorrect component state reuse when the filtered rule list updates.

findings.title: Rule view link in `GrafanaRuleListItem` drops the `returnTo` query parameter
findings.body: In the removed `GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx`, the view link was constructed with `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. In the new `GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx` (line 40), `href` is created with `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`)` without `returnTo`, breaking the "Back to list" navigation from the rule details page when opened from the rule list.
